description:
You are an occupational health nurse updating your facility's emergency medical treatment quick-reference binder. Using the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), look up the first aid and emergency medical treatment information for the following three chemicals:

1. Hydrofluoric Acid
2. Phenol
3. Sodium Cyanide

For each chemical:
- Search for the chemical on the CAMEO Chemicals website
- Navigate to its datasheet
- Find the first aid / emergency medical treatment section
- Record the first aid procedures for each route of exposure: inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, and ingestion
- Note any special antidotes or medical treatments mentioned

Compile all the information into a single structured reference document and save it to:
~/Documents/first_aid_protocols.txt

The file should have a clearly labeled section for each chemical, with the first aid information organized by exposure route (inhalation, skin, eyes, ingestion). Include any specific medical treatments or antidotes mentioned on the CAMEO datasheets.
